parameters.help_en:
The collection status. If this parameter is left empty, tasks in all states are queried. Valid values:
START: The task has been created and is waiting for the device to pull it.
PULL_REPLIED: The device has pulled the task.
FILE_SENDED: The log file information has been sent to the parsing pipeline.
FINISHED: The log retrieval succeeded.
FAIL_OVER: The log retrieval failed.
SUSPENDED: The log retrieval timed out.
CANCELLED: The task has been canceled
parameters.help_zh:
采集状态，为空查询全状态
START  任务已创建，等待设备拉取
PULL_REPLIED 设备已拉取到任务
FILE_SENDED 日志文件信息已发送给解析链路
FINISHED 日志拉取成功
FAIL_OVER 日志拉取失败
SUSPENDED 日志拉取超时
CANCELLED 任务已取消

Items.description_en: The list of device log tasks

items.description_en:
The fields are described as follows:

id String: The record ID. For non-proactive reporting, this is typically the same as the task ID. For proactive reporting, this is the collection record ID.
taskId String: The task ID. For non-proactive reporting, this is typically the same as id. For proactive reporting, this is the system-generated collection task ID.
taskName String: The task name. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
appId String: The application dimension ID, in the format of `<appKey>@<os>`.
appKey String: The application AppKey.
sourceType String: The log source type. USER indicates a log retrieval task created from the console. POSITIVE indicates proactive reporting from the device.
taskType String: The task type. Fixed as REMOTE_LOG for remote logging.
status String: The current status. Common values are NORMAL for task-level status and FINISHED for completed proactive reporting.
reason Object: The reason object. For non-proactive reporting, this typically contains type and description. For proactive reporting, this may contain only extraInfo.
mode String: The task mode. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
templateConfig String: The task template configuration as a JSON string, which contains settings such as the number of days for log retrieval and the deadline.
notifySetting Object: The notification configuration object. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
author String: The initiator. For non-proactive reporting, this is the console user. For proactive reporting, this is typically the device user nickname.
authorEmpId String: The employee or account ID of the initiator. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
authorParentEmpId String: The primary account or parent account ID of the initiator. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
collectionNums Long: The total number of devices for the task. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
successNums Long: The number of successful collections. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
failNums Long: The number of failed collections. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
fileNums Long: The number of files. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
progress String: The task progress, formatted as an internal statistics string.
dayNum Integer: The number of days for log retrieval or the valid collection period in days.
createTime Long: The creation time, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
modifyTime Long: The modification time, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
firstTime Long: The response time of the first device, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value is 0 if no device has responded.
succeededTime Long: The time when the task was completed, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value is 0 if the task is not completed.
deviceId String: The device ID. Returned for proactive reporting records.
userName String: The user nickname. Returned for proactive reporting records.
sessionId String: The session ID. Returned for proactive reporting records. This value may be empty.
requestId String: The request ID for proactive reporting.
positiveComment String: The comment for proactive reporting.
expireTime Long: The expiration time of the collection record, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
fileSize Long: The number of uploaded files or the file size. In proactive reporting scenarios, this typically indicates the number of files.
appVersion String: The application version. Returned for proactive reporting records.
os String: The device operating system name. This may be the raw value from the device.
osVersion String: The operating system version.
brand String: The device brand.
deviceModel String: The device model.
geo String: The region information
items.description_zh:
按你给的字段内容转换如下：

id String 记录 ID，非主动上报时通常等同任务 ID，主动上报时为采集记录 ID
taskId String 任务 ID，非主动上报时通常与 id 相同，主动上报时为系统生成的采集任务 ID
taskName String 任务名称，非主动上报任务返回
appId String 应用维度 ID，格式为 `<appKey>@<os>`
appKey String 应用 AppKey
sourceType String 日志来源类型，USER 表示控制台创建的回捞任务，POSITIVE 表示端上主动上报
taskType String 任务类型，远程日志固定为 REMOTE_LOG
status String 当前状态，任务维度常见 NORMAL，主动上报完成后常见 FINISHED
reason Object 发起原因对象，非主动上报通常包含 type、description，主动上报可能仅包含 extraInfo
mode String 任务模式，非主动上报任务返回
templateConfig String 任务模板配置 JSON 字符串，包含日志回捞天数、截止时间等配置
notifySetting Object 通知配置对象，非主动上报任务返回
author String 发起人，非主动上报为控制台用户，主动上报通常为设备用户昵称
authorEmpId String 发起人员工或账号 ID，非主动上报任务返回
authorParentEmpId String 发起人主账号或上级账号 ID，非主动上报任务返回
collectionNums Long 任务采集设备总数，非主动上报任务返回
successNums Long 成功采集数量，非主动上报任务返回
failNums Long 失败采集数量，非主动上报任务返回
fileNums Long 文件数量，非主动上报任务返回
progress String 任务进度，格式为系统内部统计串
dayNum Integer 回捞天数或采集有效天数
createTime Long 创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
modifyTime Long 修改时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
firstTime Long 首台设备响应时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳，未发生时为 0
succeededTime Long 成功完成时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳，未完成时为 0
deviceId String 设备 ID，主动上报记录返回
userName String 用户昵称，主动上报记录返回
sessionId String 会话 ID，主动上报记录返回，可能为空
requestId String 主动上报请求 ID
positiveComment String 主动上报备注
expireTime Long 采集记录过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fileSize Long 已上传文件数量或文件大小字段，当前主动上报场景常表示文件数
appVersion String App 版本，主动上报记录返回
os String 设备系统名称，可能为端上原始值
osVersion String 系统版本
brand String 设备品牌
deviceModel String 设备机型
geo String 地域信息
